stem: A bench has dried organic residue before disinfection. What sequence best supports an effective sanitation process?
choices: Apply disinfectant over the residue and leave it in place
Remove soil and organic debris with the approved cleaning step, then apply the approved disinfectant as directed
Skip cleaning if the disinfectant has a strong odor
Rinse with irrigation solution and consider the bench sanitized
rationale: Physical cleaning removes material that can shield contaminants or interfere with disinfection. The approved disinfection step follows cleaning when required.
